title: Automatic City/Road Building map tools for Godot
author: Valentinevandal1986
selftext: Hey, I was working on this city map thing for an open world and I decided that I didn't like the way Astra was making roads and it occurred to me that it might be better to try an approach like City Skylines or SimCity to build out the map so I developed a plugin, with Astra, that essentially turns the Godot editor window into a skylines-esque tool for placing down roads, editing terrain and placing buildings and other assets. I'm not sure if this would be useful to other people or not but I'm still testing it presently. Comment if you want me to post it and once it's done I'll update the post.
